messages:
sam.dev: quick check — we started seeing 401s from the hosted API only when requests come from the systemd service on prod. same env var works locally and in GH Actions. anyone seen systemd munging secrets?

maria-sdk: hmm can you paste the Authorization header (sanitized) or how you build it?

sam.dev: we set API_KEY in /etc/default/myapp and systemd loads with EnvironmentFile=/etc/default/myapp. app forms header as: `Authorization: Basic ${base64(API_KEY + ':')}`. curl from the container works. systemd service requests get 401.

liam-ops: systemd EnvironmentFile parsing strips quotes and may keep trailing CRLFs depending on how file was written. also some editors add a final newline. can you cat -v the file?

anya: quick diagnostics: inside the running process, run `printf %s "$API_KEY" | od -An -t c` to show hidden chars. also `echo -n "$API_KEY" | base64` vs `echo "$API_KEY" | base64` difference.

sam.dev: ran `od -c` and see `"\n"` at end. aha. we wrote file on Windows then scp'd it.

maria-sdk: yep that trailing \r or \n will change the base64 payload. server expects `base64(apiKey + ':')` exactly. with newline you get `base64(apiKey + '\n:')` which decodes differently. SDKs often do `Buffer.from(key + ':').toString('base64')` — that assumes no newline.

liam-ops: quick workaround in systemd service: set `EnvironmentFile=-/etc/default/myapp` then in ExecStart use `sh -lc 'export API_KEY=$(printf "%s" "$API_KEY" | tr -d "\r\n"); exec /usr/bin/myapp'` so you clean it at start. more permanent: fix file encoding.

sam.dev: thanks. couple follow-ups — 1) how to sanity-check Basic header quickly in shell, 2) any language-specific gotchas for Go / Python / node when password is empty?

maria-sdk: 1) easy: `echo -n "$API_KEY:" | base64` should match the header value after the word Basic. or `printf "%s" "$API_KEY:" | base64`. 2) Node: `Buffer.from(apiKey + ':').toString('base64')` — make sure you don't accidentally stringify a Buffer with newline. Python: `base64.b64encode((api_key + ':').encode()).decode()`; Go: `req.SetBasicAuth(apiKey, "")` will handle the colon for you. but note some HTTP proxies will normalize headers and *may* drop an empty password in logs; that doesn't affect auth but confuses debugging.

anya: also remember curl automatically adds `Authorization: Basic` if you use `-u user:password`. `curl -u $API_KEY:` will stop treating `:` in certain shells if empty; prefer `curl -u "$API_KEY:"` or `-H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n "$API_KEY:" | base64)"`.

liam-ops: other weirdness: if your key contains special leading characters like `@` or `$`, systemd escaping or shell interpolation can change it. always wrap in single quotes when editing files or use `printf '%s'` to write.

sam.dev: implemented tr -d in ExecStart and replaced the file with linux-safe newline. retested from prod and auth succeeded (:tada:). one more — devex-bot asked if this should be in FAQ?

maria-sdk: yes please add a short entry: "CI/systemd: strip CR/LF when loading API keys; use echo -n / printf; validate header with echo -n 'KEY:' | base64". include examples for Node/Python/Go and curl.

devops-bot: note created: DOC-1281 "systemd env CRLF -> Basic auth 401" assigned to liam-ops

anya: also adding tiny snippet to SDK debug docs: show computed Authorization header in debug logs but mask middle of key (e.g., `Basic <first4>...<last4>`).

sam.dev: awesome thanks everyone, closing the loop.
